# Piyush Doorwar

> Personal portfolio of Piyush Doorwar, a backend engineer and builder based in Mumbai, India. Explore his software projects, engineering writing, books, and music released as Proto Elyon.

Piyush works with C#, .NET, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure. His projects include desktop applications, editor and browser extensions, and developer utilities.

The portfolio is a single page; section links below point to parts of that page. Project websites provide their own documentation and downloads. For Dev Tools usage, follow its dedicated LLM index.

## Portfolio

- [Homepage](https://piyushdoorwar.com/): Profile and overview.
- [About](https://piyushdoorwar.com/#about): Background and technical skills.
- [Experience](https://piyushdoorwar.com/#experience): Work history and roles.
- [Projects](https://piyushdoorwar.com/#projects): Featured software and developer tools.
- [Writing and books](https://piyushdoorwar.com/#writing): Articles and published books.
- [Music](https://piyushdoorwar.com/#music): Proto Elyon releases and listening links.

## Projects

- [Lumyn Media Player](https://piyushdoorwar.com/lumyn-media-player/): Cross-platform desktop media player focused on distraction-free playback.
- [Gitable](https://gitable.piyushdoorwar.com/): VS Code extension for everyday Git workflows.
- [npm LL](https://piyushdoorwar.com/npmll/): VS Code package manager for npm dependencies, updates, vulnerabilities, and deprecations.
- [NuGet LL](https://piyushdoorwar.com/NuGetLL/): VS Code package manager for NuGet dependencies and package health across .NET projects.
- [AskBetter](https://piyushdoorwar.com/ask-better/): Chrome extension for improving AI prompts.
- [Transmux](https://piyushdoorwar.com/transmux/): Desktop audio and video converter built with .NET and Avalonia.
- [FluxBar](https://piyushdoorwar.com/fluxbar/): GNOME Shell extension displaying live network speed in the top bar.
- [Dev Tools](https://piyushdoorwar.com/dev-tools/): Browser-based developer utilities that process tool inputs locally.
- [Yamlet](https://yamlet.piyushdoorwar.com/): Local-first desktop API client and command-line runner for Git-friendly YAML collections.
- [Dockyard](https://piyushdoorwar.com/dockyard/): Local Docker browser UI for containers, Compose stacks, logs, metrics, and repository discovery.
- [mojify](https://piyushdoorwar.com/mojify/): Wayland-native emoji picker for Ubuntu and GNOME that copies selected emoji to the clipboard.
